inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev5 multi-bone/CUBICSPLINE animation work, dev4 MOTN/ANIM creation, dev3 TEX synthesis, dev2 native schema synthesis, dev1 integrated mod staging, dev28 TXIF graph, dev27 scene graph, dev26 mesh graph, dev25 retail GMX evidence, native builders and source-only gates are inherited. dev6 removes the mandatory GMX root/template dependency through canonical root synthesis and gltf2gmx-new.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 80/80 selftests plus CLI/GUI version checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: Template-free GMX creation is structurally regression-tested; arbitrary original scenes still require emulator/hardware runtime validation.
Platform shader microcode compilation remains unresolved; SHAD synthesis covers the fixed metadata record only.
Standard glTF skin/joint-weight import is not yet implemented.
Root +0x08 and +0x28..+0x2F remain semantically unresolved and default to zero unless explicitly overridden.
The external dev25 306/306 retail GMX evidence is inherited rather than re-run from proprietary inputs.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
